summary: A formula dataset such as Expected Net Loss % * Earned Premium now always recalculates from current copies of its inputs, and a save tells you when a dependent could not be refreshed and why.
details: After a source table import, a quarterly formula no longer reads an out-of-date quarterly copy of an annual Engine dataset.
A source table import rebuilds a vector at the period it is shown at instead of resetting it to 12 months.
